Powered By: 3SVK-  “National Student Cloud & AI Innovation Challenge – Season 3”

Hosted by 3SVK Ecosystem Platform

Season 3 Execution & Submission Live! Following an incredible response with over 4,000+ registered builders, the Season 3 submission window is officially live as of September 8, 2026. Our technical review and code audit teams are actively processing GitHub pull requests and project submissions. Access the portal directly at the 3SVK Research S3 Website. ([https://sites.google.com/view/3svk-research-s3/home](https://sites.google.com/view/3svk-research-s3/home)) Final results and merit listings will be announced shortly on this portal!

Evaluation & Submission Audit Timeline

  • Dates: Oct 11, 2026, 09:00 AM IST — Oct 25, 2026, 09:00 PM IST.

  • Process: Organizers review participant GitHub profiles, audit pull requests, and verify submitted documents.

What's Next? Expanding the Ecosystem! Building on the massive momentum of Seasons 1, 2, and 3, the 3SVK ecosystem continues to scale with deeper enterprise tracks and continuous research opportunities for student innovators.

Rewards & Ecosystem Perks

  • Winner & Runners-up: Exclusive 1-on-1 startup mentorship and product-scale acceleration from the 3SVK core engineering team, physical tech gadgets/prizes in-kind, and priority access to future 3SVK industry networking cohorts.

  • Strategic Profile Vetting: Top-performing prototypes will be featured in our curated Technical Talent Dossier, shared directly with prominent enterprise networks and ecosystem tech scouts for talent vetting visibility.

  • All Qualifiers: Official Certificate of Merit and verified project micro-credentials from 3SVK to boost engineering resumes and GitHub profiles.

Official 3SVK Ecosystem Hubs (Join for Real-Time Updates):

To ensure you don’t miss the official launch of Season 3, upcoming masterclasses, result declarations, or mentor alignment calls, connect with us across our active community pipelines:

    • Official Announcements (WhatsApp Channel): https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbCoKvoCcW4okw8fh315

    • Real-Time Support & Queries (WhatsApp Hub): https://chat.whatsapp.com/FMpS9K6cKqf3eyJX80jdbJ

    • Corporate & Project Updates (LinkedIn): https://www.linkedin.com/company/3svk/

    • Technical Masterclasses & Demos (YouTube): https://www.youtube.com/@3SVKOfficial

    • Community Highlights (Instagram): https://www.instagram.com/3svk_official/

  • Enterprise Notice & Administration: This national challenge is independently engineered, managed, and executed by 3SVK Ecosystem Platform (A Registered MSME Enterprise: UDYAM-TS-20-0182112). Academic listings, local campus anchors, and historic institutional partner tracks serve exclusively to map target student demographic student pools and do not constitute corporate liability or direct operational hosting by the affiliate universities. All compliance, data curation, and talent vetting frameworks are owned entirely by 3SVK.
